about_short_description.short_description: Quantstamp is a blockchain security company that offers security services and advisory support to prominent blockchain projects.

product.name: Smart Contract Security Audits
product.description: Comprehensive reviews of smart contract code to identify vulnerabilities, logic errors, and security risks before deployment.

product.name: Infrastructure Audits
product.description: Security assessments of blockchain infrastructure components such as consensus mechanisms and cross-chain communication relayers.

product.name: Economic Exploit Analysis
product.description: Automated and manual analysis to detect vulnerabilities related to economic attacks like flash loan exploits in DeFi protocols.

product.name: Managed Security Services
product.description: Ongoing security monitoring and management services to maintain the security posture of blockchain projects post-deployment.

product.name: Chainproof Insurance Product
product.description: An insurance offering that protects customers against smart contract hacks and slashing risks.
